text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um... "Currently doing voluntary morning training.
The view was so beautiful!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...
'Let's do our best in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!'

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Only two months left...
I have to do everything I can until then.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I'm fine. It doesn't hurt anymore. Must've just been my imagination... ...I'm totally okay."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I'd better make sure
to stretch a little more thoroughly.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Amidst the light of dawn, the summer leading toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn) came to an end.
